about.title: The Familist CPS Advocacy Model
paragraphs: This service was created by a dual board-certified mental health clinician with extensive CPS system experience. Our familist approach recognizes that child safety, parental capacity, and family stability are interconnected—allowing families to receive guidance that aligns with how CPS actually evaluates risk, progress, and parental capacity while strengthening the entire family system.

A familist approach recognizes that child safety, parental capacity, and family stability are interconnected. Rather than focusing on blame or punishment, familist CPS advocacy strengthens the entire family system—supporting parents, caregivers, and children together—while aligning with CPS expectations and court requirements.
